LIVER & SPLEEN
Liver is normal in size, shape and  parenchymal echogenicity. It has smooth contour and no focal lesion seen. The portal and hepatic veins are also normal in diameter and wall thickness. Spleen is normal in size and echo pattern.
GALL BLADDER & BILIARY TRACTS
GB is normal in size and wall thickness. No mass lesion or stone seen. Both the intra and extra-hepatic biliary ducts are normal in caliber.
BOWELS & PERITONEUM
No stomach wall thickening or focal mass seen. Bowel loops are normal in caliber and wall thickness. No mass lesion seen. No free fluid collection in the peritoneal cavity. There is multiple echogenic wall tubular structure in the intestinal lumen.
RETROPERITONEAL ORGANS
Both kidneys have normal size, shape, position and echotexture. They show normal parenchyma & sinus echo. No stone or hydro nephrosis bilaterally.
Suprarenal fossae are normal in appearance.
Pancreas is normal in size, it has homogeneous echo. No focal lesion, calcifications or ductal dilatation seen.  The abdominal aorta and IVC are also normal in caliber. No focal dilatation or intra-luminal thrombus seen. No para-aortic lymphadenopathy seen.
PELVIS:
Well-distended normal wall thickness urinary bladder with no focal mass seen. Uterus is normal in size, shape and echo pattern with no focal myometrial nor endometrial lesion seen. Adnexae are free bilaterally.

CONCLUSION; INTESTINAL PARASITES.
